newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares index ends sharply down.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares index ends sharply down.

text.p: Manila stocks closed in negative territory on Monday on fears of a fall in property prices and on account of a fall in the Dow, traders said.
The main index closed down 43.94 points, or 1.48 percent, at 2,932.84 points, but off the day's low of 2,916.48 due to short covering, brokers added.
"There's no doubt that people got scared of what happened in New York," said Irving Ackerman, president at I. Ackerman & Co.
